title: fix: guard chart data to prevent crash on non-array input
body:
`object-chart` crashes with `r.slice is not a function` when `boundData` (from `useDataScope`) or `schema.data` resolves to a non-array truthy value (e.g., an object). Recharts internally calls `.slice()` on the data prop expecting an array.

Added `Array.isArray()` guards at three layers:

- **`ObjectChart.tsx`** — validate resolved data before passing to `ChartRenderer`
- **`ChartRenderer.tsx`** — validate `schema.data` in the useMemo adapter
- **`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`** — defensive guard on `data` prop before it reaches Recharts

```tsx
// Before — non-array truthy value flows through unchecked
const finalData = boundData || schema.data || fetchedData || [];

// After
const rawData = boundData || schema.data || fetchedData;
const finalData = Array.isArray(rawData) ? rawData : [];
```
